# Vendored barcode decoder

`zxing-0.23.0.min.js` is the unmodified UMD bundle from **@zxing/library 0.23.0**, obtained from the official npm registry. It is served locally so image decoding works without BarcodeDetector or a CDN connection. License: Apache-2.0; see `ZXING-LICENSE.txt`.

- Project: https://github.com/zxing-js/library
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zxing/library/v/0.23.0
- Bundle SHA-256: `3EDE94153FB0C5B67A12D7ADFF6DECD827C2B22714FDC6FAECF27A8F20937EA6`

To reproduce: `npm pack @zxing/library@0.23.0`, extract `package/umd/index.min.js`, and retain the package license. No npm installation is needed to run CareCard.
